operationalUnknownsOutsideThe44: YouTube: verified-account custom-thumbnail availability and actual channel/search/feed/desktop presentation untested.
TikTok: native cover selector precision/profile/search crop, actual account and current controls untested.
Instagram: cover image selector/grid/feed crop/persistence and actual account controls untested.
Facebook: separate title/thumbnail controls, Page/feed crop/obstructions and actual Page identity/settings untested.
All: platform transcoding, optional caption duplication, synthetic-audio label appearance, live reuse/settings and mobile playback untested.
Selected cover identities are immutable. A fallback that changes selected media must receive a versioned manifest, not an implicit approval transfer.
potentialBlockingFindingsIfObserved: An essential caption/label/historical qualification cropped or obscured by controls requires scoped presentation remediation. No owner waiver overrides a known collision.
Live account cannot use the exact selected cover: revise that package/cover manifest and renew review; never silently substitute media. This alone does not require a new master.

Synthetic-audio disclosure unavailable or omitted in the live composer: resolve the required disclosure before release. Prepared copy/settings contain the disclosures, but no live labels have been applied.
preservation: All existing tracked files, master, narration/caption inputs, approved history, journal state and release packages remain byte-identical to sourceCommit. Only this additive audit and its summary are created.
